stories.title: Mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case
stories.summary: A judge declared a mistrial in the case of Lindsay Clancy, charged with murdering her three children, after a jury that defense attorney Kevin Reddington said was 11-1 for acquittal deadlocked. The lone holdout became the story of the day as #IAmTheHoldout trended, and so did Reddington, who told reporters outside court that the other jurors "were robbed by one man". Nick Sortor's video from the courtroom as the mistrial was declared got 107K likes.
